# Isaiah Chapter 27 -- The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

*[Full formal translation of all 13 verses]*

*Leviathan slain; pleasant vineyard (contrast ch.5); atonement; great trumpet; worship on Zion*

---

## LOGOS Translation Notes

**Key passage:** In that day the LORD will thresh from the flowing Euphrates to the Brook of Egypt. This chapter leviathan slain.

*-- LOGOS*
